race.comment: SNOWDOME (2) improved quickly last start to miss in a photo finish from up on the speed. That effort rates highly and he has won 2/4 when third-up in the past. A better draw this time should see him up front from the outset again and with further improvement in store, he can end his winning drought. IMMORTAL BLISS (6) stuck on well last start but couldn't repeat the dose when 0.9L off the winner. Drawn out again, but he's in top form and with good speed engaged again, he can storm over the top. MADHI GIRL (10) was better last start and is inching toward another win. Keep safe. JAZ SESSION (9) is better than she showed last time out and can bounce back to form.
